items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: See, I, I had a cousin, uh, that played music. He was a clarinet player. His name was Johnny Peugeot.

ctx.x: background was mostly from my, uh, uh, mother's side.

See, I, I had a cousin, uh, that played music. He was a clarinet player. His name was Johnny Peugeot. And, uh, he played with, uh, Papa Lane's band and, uh, Uses band. We used to call it Puckeye Uses band. We used to call it Puckeye Uses band. And, uh. We used to call it Puck Iuse's band. A fellow with Glass Eye used to play cornet. And played with Fish's band in those days. He was the one who got me started in playing the band, you know, because they used to book parades. They'd have about ten men in a band.…
To get you started. What did your cousin say? They'd have ten men and there'd be four niggers, five dummies?
